items.name: Acid Flask (Moderate, Infused)
items.description:
Activate A Strike

This flask filled with corrosive acid deals 1 acid damage, 2d6 persistent acid damage, and 2 acid splash damage. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Frost Vial (Moderate, Infused)
items.description:
Activate 1 Strike

The liquid reagents in this vial rapidly absorb heat when exposed to air. A frost vial deals the listed cold damage and cold splash damage. On a hit, the target takes a status penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn. Many types of frost vial also grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls, the bomb deals 2d6 cold damage and 2 cold splash damage, and the target takes a –10-foot penalty.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Frost Vial]

items.name: Alchemist's Tools
items.description: This mobile collection of vials and chemicals can be used for simple alchemical tasks.

items.name: Bracelet of Dashing
items.description:
This jangling, silvery bracelet makes you lighter on your feet, giving you a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks.

Activate A command

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain a +10-foot status bonus to Speed for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Bracelet of Dashing]

items.name: Formula Book
items.description: A formula book holds the formulas necessary to make items other than the common equipment from this chapter; alchemists typically get one for free. Each formula book can hold the formulas for up to 100 different items. Formulas can also appear on parchment sheets, tablets, and almost any other medium; there's no need for you to copy them into a specific book as long as you can keep them on hand to reference them.

generalAbilities.name: Infused Items
generalAbilities.description: Pesgahi carries the following infused items, which last for 24 hours or until the next time he makes his daily preparations: Antidote (Lesser) (2), Smokestick (Lesser) (2), Acid Flask (Moderate) (6), Frost Vial (Moderate) (4)

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Consume Flesh
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Pesgahi is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour.

Effect Pesgahi devours a chunk of the corpse and regains 2d6 Healing Damage Hit Points.

He can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ghoul Fever
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 19 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 2d6 Void Damage damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 2d6 Void Damage damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a Ghoul the next midnight.

offensiveAbilities.name: Paralysis
offensiveAbilities.description: Any living, non-elf creature hit by Pesgahi's attack must succeed at a DC 19 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Paralyzed. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Bomber
offensiveAbilities.description: Pesgahi can use Interact to draw a bomb and then Strike with it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swift Leap
offensiveAbilities.description: Pesgahi jumps up to half his Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
